rt: Distinguish covers, indexes and substantive hearing dialogue from other reporter-transcript material using the page structure.
ct: Distinguish judicial minute orders, authored reports and structured court forms from covers, indexes and other clerk-record material. Use the source document's function, not its topic alone.
first_hearing: Look for the court calling the case and participants stating appearances. A continued page number alone does not establish a new hearing.
first_minute: Look for the order heading, date and first-page indicators. Do not split a continued order solely because a new issue appears.
first_form: Use the form title and first-page indicators to distinguish the start of a form from its continuation.
date_hearing: Use the date of the hearing identified on its opening page. Do not substitute a filing, certification or footer date.
date_minute: Use the date of the judicial proceeding or order identified on the first page. Preserve uncertainty when multiple dates cannot be resolved.
